title: Project-Wide ElizaWy Asset Authority and Tree-First World

Added project-wide authority, route, editor-library, audit-contract, and root-catalog metadata for ten asset domains.

Rebuilt Willowmere outskirts around a tree-first ecology pass after infrastructure clearances; the deterministic scene contains 55 trees across eight IDs and 174 natural objects total.
Made runtime and native editor object selection coordinate-deterministic and removed generic nature fallback rendering; missing authored bindings are omitted and diagnosed.
Integrated dependency provenance, cached strict repository audit, object-atlas generation, and tree-first world materialization into Windows and shell Build all workflows.
